subway.definition:
n an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)
n an underground tunnel or passage enabling pedestrians to cross a road or railway
subway.translation:
n. 地铁, 地道
vi. 乘地铁

subway system.translation: [网络] 地铁系统；地铁网；地道系统

subways.definition:
n. an electric railway operating below the surface of the ground (usually in a city)
n. an underground tunnel or passage enabling pedestrians to cross a road or railway
subways.translation: n. 地下人行道( subway的复数形式 ); <美>地铁

subwoofer.definition: n. a loudspeaker that is designed to reproduce very low bass frequencies
subwoofer.translation: （扩音器的）低音炮, 低音音箱

subwoofers.definition:
-s form of subwoofer
n. a loudspeaker that is designed to reproduce very low bass frequencies
subwoofers.translation: (subwoofer 的第三人称 -s形式)  （扩音器的）低音炮, 低音音箱

subworker.definition: n. A subordinate worker or helper.
